title: Skills & Technologies
introduction: Explore the tools and ideas in my skill inventory. Choose a skill to see what it means and find related work where a source documents its use.
instructions: Select a skill to explore it. Select it again to clear, or choose another to compare. Use Tab to move and Enter or Space to select.
inventoryNote: This inventory combines owner-supplied skills with tools listed in project documentation. It does not assign proficiency scores.
chooseDescription: Choose any skill from the groups to read a simple explanation and explore documented project connections.
unknownDescription: The skill may have moved or the link may be incomplete. Choose a skill below or clear the selection to start again.
relatedNote: Connections come from supplied README or resume technology listings. They document a tool's inclusion; they do not independently verify implementation or results. Open a project for its full context.
emptyDescription: The supplied project sources do not currently connect this skill to a project. More examples can be added when supporting details are available.
